method: truth derived from the wasm parse tree by script/m60/lua-truth-oracle.ts; the analyzer's own output is never an input to the truth side

mirroredPolicy.why: A policy about the label a require carries. The EDGE still has to be found, so a dropped require still shows as missing.

mirroredPolicy.rule: pcall/xpcall wrapping require is `imports`, and the pcall call itself is not a `calls` edge
mirroredPolicy.why: The wrapper is transport, not a call target the user asked about. Measured rather than assumed: lua's pcall is a stdlib wrapper, and the analyzer's choice is visible in its own source.

mirroredPolicy.rule: a global function is `global` as its `from`
mirroredPolicy.why: The scope name for top level. Structural, but the alternative (inventing a file scope) would fabricate a node that does not exist.

exportsDirectPath.note: exports compared through parseWithAnalyzer, because the pipeline discards the field (LUA-14). Measured on the same tree-derived truth as every other label.

metadataDirectPath.note: M60 LUA-36. LUA-02, LUA-04, LUA-10 and LUA-11 are metadata defects and had a dedicated gate but NO corpus test, because this instrument compared only relationships and exports. The truth side is re-derived from the tree: coroutine CALLS counted by node type, and the framework rule re-implemented from the contract rather than copied from the analyzer, because a copy agrees by construction and proves nothing.

architecturalScore.note: LUA-10/LUA-11 are about whether this number MOVES. One distinct value across a whole corpus is a constant wearing a number, and that is the check; the mean is reported so a reader can see the spread rather than be told it is fine.

surfaceDisclosures.note: M60 LUA-35. A module surface that carries no NAME is disclosed rather than published, so 'no exports' stops meaning two indistinguishable things. Counted on the direct path.

relationshipsDirectPath.note: analyzer output vs the same tree-derived truth, read through parseWithAnalyzer. Exists because pool-worker DROPS any relationship target containing a newline, so a multi-line payload target is invisible through the pipeline — the blind spot that hid LUA-32 for an entire lane. `spurious` is the leg that catches a target the tree never derived.

pipelineDiscardEvidence.note: a label is called discarded ONLY where the direct path supplied it and the pipeline did not, on the same file. Absence on both sides proves nothing.
